comparator.name: Biology
comparator.sourceNotes: The live 2026-2027 Leiden Study Guide accounts for three 60-EC years. Year 1 is a compulsory 60-EC molecules-to-ecosystems foundation. Year 2 consists of 13 EC shared study plus the 47-EC Biology specialisation: 17 EC required and a coherent 30-EC restricted-elective set selected here across biochemistry, cell biology, microbiology, biodiversity and ecology. Year 3 contains 30 EC of genuine elective/minor space, 6 EC of required skills and statistics, and one 24-EC Bachelor Research Project. The current programme group fixes the Year 3 required total at 6 EC; the component allocation uses the formally documented 1+2+3 EC distribution because the separate live Statistics 2 module endpoint reports 4 EC, which would conflict with both the 60-EC year and 180-EC degree totals.

alternatives.distinctnessRationale: Compared with the broad biological-sciences route, this programme replaces introductory biodiversity, conservation biology, ecosystems, evolution, soils, marine biology and sustainability governance with a brain-and-behaviour gateway, neural networks, perception, higher-order functions, machine learning, psycholinguistics and image processing. Seven courses differ in each direction, producing a substantially more molecular, biomedical and computational programme.

alternatives.concept: Centres evolution, biodiversity, ecological processes and conservation while retaining cellular, physiological, microbial, laboratory and statistical foundations. Climate, soils, biogeochemistry, marine biology and delta research connect organisms and ecosystems to environmental change and management.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The current generic Biology bachelor offers a 47-EC second-year choice between Biology and Bioinformatics after the shared 60-EC first year. Biology is the broad route that preserves the named programme's organismal, molecular, evolutionary, ecological and biodiversity identity; Bioinformatics is the narrower computational specialisation. Within the Biology route, a 30-EC elective set spanning molecular, microbial, organismal and ecosystem biology is selected before and independently of UCR fit.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The broad closest match covers Leiden Biology's molecules-to-ecosystems identity. Two direct programme-interest clusters support coherent, substantially distinct alternatives: molecular/cellular biology linked to health and computation, and ecology/evolution/conservation linked to environmental change. All three retain feasible 24-course schedules and differ well beyond the four-course minimum. Production stops at the maximum of three defensible alternatives.

notes.text: Leiden Biology requires a broad first year, a 47-EC second-year Biology specialisation with molecular, organismal, evolutionary and ecological work, and a third year containing 30 EC of open choice plus a 24-EC Bachelor Research Project. UCR can assemble broad, molecular/biomedical and ecology/evolution programmes from current courses, but it does not reproduce Leiden's full organismal and field sequence or the required 24-EC research project; shared rows show substantive overlap rather than full equivalence.
